title: JESUS, HIGH IN GLORY
author: Harriet B. McKeever
stanzas: Jesus, high in glory, Lend a listening ear; When we bow before Thee, children's praises hear
Though Thou art so holy, Heav'n's almighty King, Thou wilt stoop to listen When Thy praises we sing.
We are little children, weak and apt to stray; Savior, guide and keep us In the heav'nly way
Save us, Lord, from sinning; Watch us day by day; Help us now to love Thee; Take our sins away.
Strengthen us for duty, While on earth we live; May we to Thy service our best talents give.
Then when Jesus calls us To our heav'nly home, We will gladly answer, " Savior, Lord, We come."
